## Context
A deterministic relocated-store experiment confirmed that `src/rebar/_engine_support/commit_impact.py::code_root_for` conflates tracker storage with the code repository. `attach_commits` reaches it through `_lib_mutations.py`; with an absolute `REBAR_TRACKER_DIR` outside the code checkout, valid code commit SHAs are checked against the tracker parent and rejected. Runtime tracing observed `git -C <tracker-parent> rev-parse` while the same SHA resolved at the code root.

## Plan
- Add a real-git held-out regression oracle with a code repository and independently relocated ticket store.
- Resolve commit validation from `config.repo_root(repo_root)` (explicit root, then `REBAR_ROOT`, then cwd Git top-level), while retaining tracker reads/writes through `REBAR_TRACKER_DIR`.
- Remove the obsolete tracker-parent code-root helpers so the invalid derivation cannot remain as unused prior art.
- Preserve all-or-nothing rejection for unknown SHAs and the default in-repo tracker path.
- Run RED to GREEN, exact-defect mutation, focused store and attach suites, lint, typecheck, and original CLI replication.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] A valid code commit is accepted when the ticket store is outside the code worktree.
- [ ] An unknown SHA remains rejected without recording a partial COMMITS event.
- [ ] Default in-repo tracker behavior remains unchanged.
- [ ] The held-out relocated-store test is observed RED before repair and GREEN after repair.
- [ ] The exact tracker-parent mutation returns the held-out test to RED.
- [ ] Focused tests pass.
- [ ] `make lint` passes.
- [ ] `make typecheck` passes.

## Testing
- `pytest tests/interfaces/store/test_commits_on_ticket.py tests/unit/test_attach_commits.py`
- `make lint`
- `make typecheck`
